q: Jaundice appearing in the first 24 hours of life is most likely due to:
e: Early jaundice is haemolytic until proved otherwise.

q: A 5-week-old has jaundice, pale stools and dark urine. The most important diagnosis to exclude is:
The volume of a double-volume exchange transfusion for a 3-kg baby is about:
Regarding ABO incompatibility, which is TRUE?
o: It never affects the first baby
It is usually more severe than Rh disease
The mother is group O and baby A or B
e: Mother O, baby A or B; can affect the first baby; usually mild.
